Cookie Policy

Last updated: [September 19, 2026]

This Cookie Policy explains how The Modern Stoic (themodernstoic.co) uses cookies and similar tracking technologies, and how you can control them.

⚠️ Note for the site owner: Review and adjust the categories and consent behavior below to match your actual Cookie Consent implementation (RAD Section 8) before publishing.

What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help the site remember information about your visit, which can make your next visit easier and the site more useful to you.

Cookies We Use

Strictly Necessary Cookies

Required for the Site to function properly (e.g., remembering your cookie consent choice). These cannot be disabled.

Analytics Cookies

Used to understand how visitors interact with the Site — which pages are popular, how long visitors stay, and where they come from.

ProviderCookiePurpose
Google Analytics 4_ga, _ga_*Distinguishes users, measures site usage
Google Tag Manager—Manages the loading of other tracking scripts

Advertising / Marketing Cookies

Used to measure the effectiveness of our advertising and, where applicable, show relevant ads on other platforms.

ProviderCookiePurpose
Meta Pixel_fbp, frTracks conversions from Meta (Facebook/Instagram) advertising

Managing Your Preferences

When you first visit the Site, you'll see a cookie consent banner where you can accept or decline non-essential cookies (analytics and advertising). You can change your preference at any time by [clearing your browser's cookies for this site / re-opening cookie settings — adjust based on actual implementation].

Most browsers also allow you to control cookies through their settings. Note that disabling cookies may affect how the Site functions.

Consent Mode

When you decline analytics or advertising cookies, Google Analytics and Meta Pixel operate in a limited, consent-aware mode (or do not load at all, depending on configuration), in accordance with your preference.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy as our use of cookies changes. The "Last updated" date above reflects the most recent revision.

Questions?

Contact us at themodernstoicco@gmail.com with any questions about our use of cookies.
